title: TWITTER R10 Pro Gen 3 closed-wheel current option matrix
notes: Current exact-model indexing and the matching Tmall mirror expose R10 Pro Gen 3 closed-wheel configurations with either WheelTop EVO or Shimano 105 R7120 24-speed shifting. They establish the option conflict but do not identify which configuration belongs to the retained CNY 7,907.25 card, and they publish no defensible exact selected-build weight or maximum tire clearance.
